profile.headline: Software Engineer at Juniper Networks
profile.summary:
Working at Juniper Networks on the MX and PTX series routers, writing platforms code for Junos and Evo

Experience in network operating systems software development, computer networking research, and teaching computer science.

I also play volleyball and spend a lot of time enjoying nature!

Find my website here: https://estuhr1206.github.io/

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Platforms team, working on JunOS for the MX series routers

- Design and development of toolkits and device drivers for custom hardware and multiple generations of ASICs on Juniper custom silicon
- Developing platforms code and daemons in the network Operating System (Junos/Evo) for MX routers in C/C++
- Responsible for fixing and debugging SW/HW problems for vendors, including large service providers and hyperscalers
- Writing python automation scripts for router functionality to provide new features to customers and improve end to end testing
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · C++ · Computer Networking · Linux Kernel · Operating Systems

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Teaching assistant for a graduate special topics course on datacenter networks and systems. CS 8803 DNS at Georgia Tech.

positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher
positions.description: Working in the Advanced Networked Systems Research Lab. Currently investigating recently proposed congestion control and microsecond-scale, datacenter oriented operating systems.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: In charge of co leading a lab section two days a week for about 50 students. Also responsible for helping maintain the course of 750 students, including creating homework, assessments, and other assignments. Hold office hours for 3 hours a week and monitor question platforms. Additionally help with course logistics such as assignment setups and releases, proctoring and organizing makeups, and contributing to course decisions day to day and long term in support of the professors and students.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Platforms team- supporting junos and evo for MX routers
Introduced a new CLI command for MX series routers into junos, allowing fine grained firmware upgrades.
Created a visualization tool to root cause ASIC link failures and assist signal integrity teams at Juniper when debugging across 100s of data types and 100s of links per chasiss.

positions.title: Solutions Architect Intern
positions.description: Working in the Verizon Presales lab, supporting proof of concept and testing of real networking solutions. Interacting with real hardware and the associated tooling, including networking/datacenter specific REST APIs, Python, Ansible, and Terraform.

positions.title: AI-based Discovery and Innovation Team Member
positions.description: Worked on the nano photonics sub-team, using previous findings that were leveraging dimensionality reduction as a way of analyzing reflection data of nano structures. As a team, we made efforts to expand on this work, performing sensitivity analysis on a neural network that related a much simpler set of design parameters to the full spectrum of reflection data.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Scikit-Learn

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Joined a team working a classified contract, and wrote code to integrate new data models into the project’s current functional product. 

Worked in C++, and interacted with various technologies used throughout the project, including RapidXML, Docker, and Log4cplus.

positions.title: Delta Tech
positions.locationName: Orchard Park, New York, United States
positions.description: Part time job during breaks from school, trained to open/close down the location. Involved with interacting with customers and sending through/ensuring safety in the wash tunnel.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Completed my Eagle Project for a local park, Chestnut Ridge, in conjunction with the Erie County parks department and the Chestnut Ridge Conservancy. Laid down gravel for a path, had benches installed, and planted trees and shrubbery at a trailhead.
Various other activates, including training younger scouts, highway cleanups, and fundraisers for the troop.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: St. James United Church of Christ
volunteerExperiences.description:
Volunteer for church activities, including fundraisers, receptions/wakes, social events.
Organize clothing donations in a drop off shed on church property, taking unusable items to Goodwill and removing any trash.

company.name: St. James United Church of Christ
